summary: 8099: Display Key Account Fields in Header

description.raw: As a:  Salesforce User I want to:  see key Account fields at the top of the record page So that I can:  quickly understand a party’s classification and lifecycle status without scrolling Scenario: Configure compact layout with key fields Given I am a Salesforce Admin in  Setup > Object Manager > Account When I create or edit the  Account compact layout Then the following fields must be displayed in order: Field Label API Name Account Status Account_Status__c Account Type Type Party ID (PTY) Party_ID_PTY_Code__c Primary Contact Primary_Contact__c And the compact layout must be assigned to all Account page layouts And it must display consistently across all Account record types Scenario: Verify header visibility for users Given I am viewing an Account record When the page loads Then the compact layout must display in the header section And the values must update immediately when the underlying fields change Notes: These five fields are considered the  most important Account attributes . They must appear in the  header section  at the top of every Account record for easy visibility.
